summary:

description.en:
PUDU D9 is Pudu Robotics' first full-size bipedal humanoid, introduced by Pudu X-Lab in December 2024. The launch specification describes a robot 170 cm tall and 65 kg, with 42 degrees of freedom and DH11 dexterous hands.

Its demonstrations combined walking, obstacle negotiation and slope climbing with dual-hand operation. One example used the robot to operate Pudu's SH1 floor-cleaning equipment, illustrating interaction with an existing tool. D9 develops the company's embodied-intelligence approach in a walking platform, with commercial task capability dependent on the trained software, sensing and deployment conditions.
description.zh: PUDU D9是普渡机器人首款全尺寸双足人形机器人，面向具有商业应用潜力的通用具身智能任务。
